acceptance: A versioned inventory records declared, generated, runnable, excluded, and candidate-scored query IDs for every workload family.
Scored means runnable, dialect-supported, oracle-passing, and non-vacuous; exclusions use declared reason codes and never change a frozen denominator.
TPC-Havoc generation failures are surfaced deterministically, and generated IDs must equal the manifest's expected IDs.
TPC-DS OBT, Read Primitives, and ClickBench documentation and registries agree with executable manifests.
Each workload records exact dataset identity, source lineage, scale semantics, generator version, and Power/Throughput eligibility.
Focused tests fail on count drift, missing or duplicate IDs, and additions to skip_on or equivalent mechanisms that are not declared in the manifest.
context: Implements the proposed cross-benchmark score architecture. Preserve official TPC metrics as separate outputs. Numerical weights, size vectors, concurrency points, thresholds, and the M4 reference remain pilot hypotheses until methodology freeze.
description: Create a machine-verifiable inventory for every candidate benchmark before selecting scored queries. Reconcile registry, documentation, generated, and runnable counts; remove silent omission from scored paths; and pin dataset and query lineage for TPC-H, TPC-DS, SSB, ClickBench, JOB, TPC-Havoc, TPC-H Skew, TPC-DS OBT, NYC Taxi, and Read Primitives.
